_README: FILL THIS IN AND SAVE YOUR COPY AS  var/roster.json
Do not edit this file in place -- it is tracked in git and contains no real
data. Your copy is not tracked: both var/ and roster.json are gitignored.
Your copy is deliberately a separate file. A roster full of placeholders is
non-empty, so it would pass every other check and the pipeline would run at
full speed while the deny-list protected nobody -- indistinguishable from
working until a real name turns up in an outbound payload. Copying it into
place is the deliberate act that says you filled it in, and any leftover
REPLACE-ME is rejected on load rather than ignored.
WHY THIS FILE MATTERS MORE THAN ANY OTHER CONFIG
Redaction is a closed-world deny-list, and this is the list. Automatic name
detection is a supplement, never the control -- it misses roughly a third of
personal names. A member who is not in 'names' below is a member whose name
can reach Anthropic. Completeness here IS the privacy guarantee.
names -- every member, INCLUDING YOURSELF.
Add every surface form you have seen used in the chat, one string each:
full name            'Anna Smith'
first name alone     'Anna'
surname alone        'Smith'
nicknames            'Annie'
common misspellings  'Ana'
handles they use     'anna_s'
Matching is case-insensitive, and possessives (Anna's, Annas') are
generated for you. Single characters are ignored: a bare initial produces
too many false positives to be useful.
Err heavily toward adding more. A false positive costs one redacted word;
a miss costs a real name leaving the machine.
phones -- E.164, with the country code and the leading +. Include your own.
Once a number is here it is caught in ANY written form: spaced, dashed,
bracketed, without the +, or typed in non-Latin numerals. Numbers NOT in
this list are caught only when they are real, assignable numbers -- see
PRIVACY.md for why that limit exists and what it does not cover.
opted_out -- Signal ACI UUIDs of members who asked not to be included.
Leave as [] if nobody has. This takes the UUID, not the phone number.
To find one, list the group's members:
docker compose exec signal-cli signal-cli --config /data listGroups -d
That output contains real identifiers. Copy the UUID straight into your
roster -- do not paste that output into a chat, an issue, or a commit.
An opt-out drops their messages at ingest AND any text of theirs that
someone else quotes.
group_name -- the group's display name, exactly as it appears in Signal.
Removed from anything sent, along with the group ID.
THEN CHECK YOUR WORK WITHOUT SENDING ANYTHING:
docker compose --profile batch run --rm batch --dry-run
That prints the exact outbound payload and runs the egress firewall over
it. Read it yourself, and confirm every member name is gone, before you
let it make a single live call.
